name: Vampire - Misty Escape - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a feature

results.text: The vampire’s body crumbles to dust as sunlight sears its flesh, leaving only a grotesque husk.
A howl of agony splits the air as running water dissolves the creature into nothingness.
Shadows recoil in horror as holy fire consumes the vampire where it stands, leaving no remnant behind.
The monster’s form shatters like glass against an unyielding barrier, its essence scattered to the wind.
A final gasp escapes as the undead collapses, its body dissolving into ash on the desecrated ground.
